facts.fact: The Strategy, issued by the Ministry of Information and Communications and dated December 2022, says the NDDP/NDDS project was 'accelerated and finalized in 2021' and that the Strategy sets 'a holistic national digital agenda' over seven focus areas; it names no approving act or body.

The Strategy says the National Digital Development Policy (NDDP) is 'the guiding document for digital development' on a national scale and was 'finalized in 2021' together with the NDDS; it names no approving act or body.

The Strategy's next steps ask that the new USD 50,000,000 World Bank grant for the Sierra Leone Digital Transformation Project be used for initiatives that reflect the NDDS, and name no domestic budget line for the Strategy.

The Strategy says the Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation (DSTI), created in the State House in 2018, 'launched' the National Innovation and Digital Strategy (NIDS) (2019-2029), consistent with the NDDS; it names no approving act and does not describe the strategy's scope; as_of is the Strategy's December 2022 date.
The Strategy states the period of the National Innovation and Digital Strategy (NIDS) as 2019-2029, which includes December 2022; it does not link the text. Text public: not stated

systems.country_label: Sierra Leone National Digital Development Strategy
systems.tiers: seven focus areas: governance, infrastructure, skills, digital government, e-commerce and financial services, innovation, data and cybersecurity

systems.owner: Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation (State House)

note: No adoption verb is given for the NDDS or NDDP, only 'finalized in 2021' (and the cover date December 2022), so 'validated' follows the closed list's 'technically complete' reading and the parent should weigh it against 'approved in 2021' in doc 42. NIDS scope is not described here, so its class is empty. The Strategy states no period of its own; the dual-document dating (2021 inside, 2022 on cover) is the document's.
